deployment_truth_path: omnicoder2026 native runtime with KDA recurrent state plus CSA/HCA sparse latent KV
adoption_bridge: qwen3-compatible GGUF for shorter-context LM Studio/llama.cpp adoption
primary_parameter_target: 20B-class dense target with mlp_dim=15360, estimated ~=19.57B trunk params and ~=22.58B including enabled MTP/residual/media/reasoning heads, ~=10.51 GiB q4 weights, sized by native-1M 24GB headroom rather than a fixed round number
stretch_parameter_target: larger than 20B only after TurboQuant native-state validation proves 24GB headroom on RTX 3090

used_for: shared trunk plus edge codec pattern

primary_20b.contract: fit 24GB at q4 with compressed native state, TurboQuant path, full 330k omnimodal ledger, native 1M context, and intentional 15360-MLP headroom for block residual attention, native media heads, and OOM margin

legacy_16b.risk: kept as an intermediate fallback and inherits the 15360-MLP headroom rule; it is no longer the main contract target

server_probe.purpose: validate construction, train loop, full 330k token ledger, sparse masks, Q4 fake quant, and AI-server deployment before scaling to primary_20b

token_space.rule: edge codecs turn raw media into ledger token IDs or continuous targets; the trunk has no learned in-trunk modality adapters

core_mechanisms: KDA/Gated-DeltaNet-style recurrent-linear layers with O(1) recurrent state
DeepSeek-V4-style CSA layers with local sliding attention, sinks, sparse compressed summaries, and top-k/prefix recall
DeepSeek-V4-style HCA layers with heavily compressed long-range summaries
DeepSeek-V4-style shared K=V MQA, low-rank Q, grouped low-rank O, trailing partial RoPE, and sink logits
mHC-lite residual/depth hooks with a future Sinkhorn hyper-connection slot
Q4-aware training for weights and swappable FP8/Q8/Q4/OScaR-style compressed runtime state
chunked prefill and paged native runtime
not_allowed_as_core_claim: full resident GQA KV at 1M on 24GB
one stock GGUF that magically provides full native 1M context

omnimodal_policy.shared_trunk: text, code, tool calls, media ledger tokens, timing tokens, and continuous flow targets share the same dense trunk

quantization.weights: Q4-aware training/fake quant with Q4_K_M GGUF bridge target
quantization.native_state: KDA recurrent state fp16/q8 first; CSA/HCA latent KV fp8/q8 then q4; OScaR INT2 historical branch experimental
quantization.turboquant: required runtime branch for q4 weights plus compressed latent KV/state; promote beyond estimator only after long-context coding/tool regression tests
